subject: Request: Exception review for Senior Inference Eng (REQ-4532) during hiring pause
messages:
From: Olga Petrov <olga_petrov@redwood.ai>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.ai>
Cc: Maya Srinivasan <maya_srinivasan@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-11-04T08:12:00-07:00
Subject: Request: Exception review for Senior Inference Eng (REQ-4532) during hiring pause

Team —

Per the org note about the temporary hiring pause effective today, I'm flagging REQ-4532 (Senior Inference Engineer) for an exception review. This role is a direct dependency for an enterprise pilot with AcroMed (we're under an NDA and the pilot kicks off in mid-Dec). Candidate (Emily Chen) is in final-stage and has indicated she will accept if we move quickly; Talent Partners submitted a profile last week.

Why this is urgent:
- Technical ownership: role is the only in-house owner for the low-latency inference path for the pilot.
- Customer timeline: AcroMed requires a point-of-contact and a performance baseline before their security review.
- Risk of losing candidate: Emily has another offer window open until Nov 17.

Ask: can we review an exception for this req (headcount already provisioned in FY26 but hiring freeze triggers require approvals) and either:
1) Approve expedited exception with an offer within comp band; OR
2) Approve a temporary contractor (") with a clear corridor for converting to FTE post-Q1 adjustments.

Attached: REQ_4532_jobdesc.pdf, candidate resume. I've summarized the candidate's fit and the business impact in the attachment.

Thanks —
Olga
Director, Solutions Architecture
Redwood Inference
From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai>
To: Olga Petrov <olga_petrov@redwood.ai>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.ai>
Cc: Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.ai>, Maya Srinivasan <maya_srinivasan@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-11-04T11:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Request: Exception review for Senior Inference Eng (REQ-4532) during hiring pause

Thanks for the context, Olga. Quick Qs to frame the exception:
- Can we quantify revenue or onboarding risk if we don't fill this before the pilot? (ballpark $ impact)
- Are there internal engineers who could cover the minimum surface for 8 weeks if we delay?
- If we approve, what's the expected comp ask relative to the band (below / at / above)?

If we can show an offset (defer one lower-priority req or convert contractor spend), I'm open to approving an exception for a critical customer-impact hire. Please include concrete numbers so finance and HR can evaluate.

-vivek
VP, Engineering
From: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.ai>
To: Olga Petrov <olga_petrov@redwood.ai>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai>
Cc: Maya Srinivasan <maya_srinivasan@redwood.ai>, Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-11-05T09:24:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Request: Exception review for Senior Inference Eng (REQ-4532) during hiring pause

Looping in comp and HR posture. Per policy: exceptions for mission-critical roles require written business justification + proposed offset. We can process a fast-track approval if leadership signs off and finance confirms offsets.

I've attached the current comp bands (comp_band_matrix_Q4_2026.xlsx). For REQ-4532 the target band midpoint is $210k total cash; strong candidates in the market are landing between 0.95-1.1x midpoint. If you need to stay strictly within band we can structure a sign-on + OTE mix to be competitive.

Next steps: please provide the business case (revenue / SLA / customer risk) and suggested offset candidate owners. HR will prepare a draft offer letter to hold for approval once we get leadership sign-off.

-Lauren
Head of Talent Operations
From: Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.ai>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai>, Olga Petrov <olga_petrov@redwood.ai>
Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.ai>, Maya Srinivasan <maya_srinivasan@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-11-05T11:50:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Request: Exception review for Senior Inference Eng (REQ-4532) during hiring pause

O/P — finance perspective. We need a concrete offset or a cost-neutral path. Options:
1) Defer one open IC req in Product (we have a lower-priority req in Q4 that can move to Q1) — saves ~1.0 FTE equivalent for our FY26 run-rate; OR
2) Approve a fixed-term contractor for up to 12 weeks at market rates (convert if needed) — this keeps headcount frozen but costs go to contractor budget.

If leadership wants a hire, propose that Engineering provide a swap candidate (mark a specific req id to pause) and confirm customer-dollar exposure (contract value or renewal risk). With that info I can greenlight an exception and sign the DocuSign approval.

-Markus
SVP Finance
From: Olga Petrov <olga_petrov@redwood.ai>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai>, Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.ai>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.ai>
Cc: Maya Srinivasan <maya_srinivasan@redwood.ai>, Randall <randall@talentpartners.com>
Date: 2026-11-06T07:18:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Request: Exception review for Senior Inference Eng (REQ-4532) during hiring pause

Thanks — answered inline: 
- Customer exposure: AcroMed pilot is scoped for a $320k potential contract in H1 (pilot converts to paid PoC / first-year ARR if we meet security/perf gates). Losing Emily delays the PoC and likely pushes the deal to next cycle (estimated revenue deferral of ~$260k in FY27).
- Internal coverage: We have two infra engineers who can triage for ~3 weeks but not own the performance tuning required by mid-Dec. That leaves a 3-5 week coverage gap.
- Expected comp ask: candidate has verbal expectation of $220k total cash; midpoint is $210k. Requested ask is ~1.05x midpoint.

Proposed offset: pause Product IC req PRD-1187 (mid-priority, can shift to Q1) — saves the same headcount slot. I'm happy to own the documentation for the business case and submit for DocuSign.

If approved, Talent Partners is prepared to hold the offer and we've drafted a targeted package (base + 6k sign-on + standard equity). Candidate's acceptance window is 11/17.

Olga
From: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.ai>
To: Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.ai>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai>, Olga Petrov <olga_petrov@redwood.ai>
Cc: Maya Srinivasan <maya_srinivasan@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-11-11T17:05:00-07:00
Subject: RE: Request: Exception review for Senior Inference Eng (REQ-4532) during hiring pause — APPROVED (conditional)

Markus has approved the headcount swap (pause PRD-1187) and finance signed off on the offset. Conditional approval granted under these terms:
- Offer must remain within 1.1x band (total cash <= $231k).
- Sign-on capped at $6k and standard equity only.
- Candidate offer window hold until 11/17; if candidate accepts, start date must be no earlier than 12/14 to allow procurement/security gating for the pilot.
- Engineering to document conversion criteria if this is initially a contractor conversion lane.

I've started the DocuSign approval packet: https://docusign.example.com/REQ4532-approval — please review and sign. Once signed, HR will issue a formal offer hold to Talent Partners to secure the candidate.

-Lauren
